steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0124_bedb_dsi_atp_per_spike_nsga2 branch from main and initialize step plan.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all 10 dependency tasks completed via verify_task_dependencies.py.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create mandatory task folder structure: assets/, corrections/, intervention/, logs/, plan/, research/, results/, code/.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review the project paper corpus for evidence on Sengupta 2010 ATP recipe, Carter-Bean 2009 AIS benchmark, Attwell-Laughlin 2001 budget, Niven 2007 bits-per-ATP curve, Cuntz 2010 wiring cost, Remme 2018 MSO MOBO template; write research/research_papers.md.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for any recent (post-corpus) DSGC energy/MOBO publications or Carter-Bean canonical-value re-derivations; write research/research_internet.md.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0123 ATP recipe / seg.ina recorder / Carter-Bean smoke-gate code, t0122 DSI silence-guard code, t0115 NSGA-II substrate; write research/research_code.md.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesize research into plan/plan.md with all 11 mandatory sections; surface every hard constraint from task_description.md in Verification Criteria; re-derive Carter-Bean canonical value (S-0123-04 partial fix).

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision Vast.ai EPYC (cheapest 32-core or 64-core); confirm SSH + environment; verify Vast.ai balance >= $7 before launch.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Copy t0123 substrate, swap MI->DSI objective, reduce N_DIRECTIONS=2; run Carter-Bean smoke-gate; launch 1-seed NSGA-II (pop=96, N_EVAL_SEEDS=3, gen_max=60, _POOL_RESTART_EVERY=10, HV-plateau auto-stop disabled, $6 cap); collect predictions asset.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance, finalize machine_log.json + remote_machines_used.json + costs.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis: DSI-ATP front shape vs Carter-Bean Na/K-overlap prediction; cross-reference to t0122 cytoplasm front for joint geometric+metabolic cost view.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json; embed Pareto front + Carter-Bean check + Attwell-Laughlin budget + top-50 morphologies + HV trajectory charts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Spawn /compare-literature subagent. Compare DSGC DSI-ATP front to Carter-Bean 2009, Attwell-Laughlin 2001, Sengupta 2010, Niven 2007, Cuntz 2010 (cross-ref to t0122), Remme 2018.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Spawn /generate-suggestions subagent. Generate follow-up suggestions for 3-objective (DSI+MI+ATP) extensions, alternative cost objectives, and any uncovered design gaps.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, mark task.json completed with end_time; final commit before PR.
